profile.summary: Mobin Azimipanah is an AI Engineer with dual M.Sc. degrees in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, specializing in machine learning, NLP, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Currently at Hermes Corporate, he consults on AI infrastructure, having previously developed an automated RAG system at Canon Research Center, fine-tuned LLMs using LoRA/quantization, and built multi-agent applications. His master's thesis explored a Multi-RAG Framework, and he led a multi-agent LLM project at a Berkeley hackathon. Skilled in PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, AutoGen, FastAPI, and AWS, with a strong full-stack foundation. EU work authorized.
